title: Boat routes (data/boat_routes.yaml)
description: T3.5: routes a captain NPC offers in the dialog nodes marked boat_routes: true. make validate also checks the dock and the arrival against world/ (packages/map-format).

captain.description: NPC that sells the route. It must stand at most 8 tiles from the dock.

text.description: Text of the dialog option (destination and price, written by hand).

from.description: Dock tile the route leaves from (walkable).

to.description: Arrival tile (walkable); if it is taken, the nearest free tile within travel.arrival_radius.

quest.description: Quest the player must have completed.

item.description: Item the player must carry; consume: true takes it (a ticket).
